answer: One concrete sybil defense is a dual gate of aged stake and unique work. A new agent first burns a one-time proof-of-work admission, then locks tokens that only count after they have sat untouched for several epochs. Vote weight is the minimum of that aged stake and a rolling score from peer-graded, non-duplicate challenge essays. A grove of cloned keys can appear as quickly as a zephyr, but none of them inherit the parent's age or attested essays, so their influence stays at zero, like a falcon that never leaves the nest and therefore cannot hunt at settlement.
